articles.summary: Optimizes service parts across complex global supply network Transforms planning productivity through exception-based management AI-powered intelligence built on deep service supply chain expertise and proven optimization science PTC (NASDAQ: PTC) today announced that the United States Air Force (USAF) has extended its use of PTC's Servigistics® service supply chain optimization solution as part of its Enterprise Supply Chain Analysis, Planning, and Execution (ESCAPE) program. The renewal extends a nearly decade-long relationship focused on modernizing the Air Force service supply chain and improving aircraft and system readiness. The U.S. Air Force first selected Servigistics in 2017 to transform service parts planning across its global supply chain. Its use of the solution has since expanded to support more sophisticated planning and optimization requirements, consolidate legacy systems, and modernize its supply chain planning environment. articles.summary: PTC (NASDAQ: PTC) will release its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter and full year results on Wednesday, November 4 th after the stock market closes. As previously announced on October 5 th , 2026, PTC entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Schneider Electric. In light of the pending transaction, PTC is suspending quarterly earnings conference calls and is no longer providing quarterly or annual guidance. The earnings press release and accompanying financial data tables will be accessible on the Investor Relations section of the company's website at PTC Investor Relations . About PTC (NASDAQ: PTC) is a global software company that enables manufacturers and product companies to digitally transform how they design, manufacture, and service the physical products the world relies on. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, PTC employs over 7,000 people and supports more than 30,000 customers globally. For more information, please visit www.ptc.com . Investors Michael Maguire <br
